note: Areas of herdrup's ipad-pro-13 references (1376x1032 pt) that are not compared, in reference points with the status bar included. Measured on the 12 PNGs at herdrup 7d802ebb (feat/desktop-reference-shots). Add a rect here to stop comparing an area.

rects.name: status-bar
rects.why: iPadOS status bar (manifest statusBar.heightPoints 32). refdiff -crop-top-pt 32 already cuts it; listed so the mask names everything not compared.

rects.name: tab-bar-glass
rects.why: The sidebar tab bar's Liquid Glass capsule with its Agents/Gram/Settings items: every pixel differing from the sidebar fill #13162A spans x 24-316, y 938-1000 pt in all six states; the fill around it is exact (no shadow).

rects.name: window-resize-corner
rects.why: iPadOS's bottom-right window-resize arc, system chrome drawn over the app (bright pixels x 1348-1371.5, y 1004-1027.5 pt in all six states), plus its anti-aliasing.
